Viasat develops software for embedded satellite terminal products used across aviation, maritime, residential, and other sectors. The Associate Embedded Software Engineer contributes to software design, development, delivery, and support, collaborating with software teams to meet development, quality, and delivery goals.

Responsibilities
You’ll be a software engineer working as part of a software team with a technical lead. You will be engaging and collaborating with other software teams working on embedded software, to achieve development, design, quality and agility goals
Software engineering as part of an agile development team
Design, develop and drive software products
Participate in design, development and code reviews of software with a view to deliver quality products in the short and long term
Collaborate and coordinate with other software engineers and teams in driving timely delivery of quality software
Produce software as an individual contributor

Required
Completion of Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field
This role is intended for someone with 0-3 years of full-time, relevant industry experience
This position requires U.S. Citizenship
Demonstrated interest in generative AI and AI-assisted software development through coursework, projects, or research
Experience in hands-on software development or relevant school projects, using C/C++
Proven experience with Linux/UNIX
Hands-on experience with Objected Oriented methodology & development
Strong analytical skills & ability to evaluate software design, including existing codebases
Strong sense of ownership
Excellent communication skills
Preferred
Experience using C/C++
Experience with Linux and bare-metal programming for embedded systems
Experience writing unit tests for C/C++
Understanding of multiheaded programming and applications
Linux HW peripheral driver development and linux kernel development
Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., git)
Make systems, particularly CMake
Posix and Bash shell scripting
Being detail oriented with strong analytical problem-solving skills
Ability to collaborate and communicate in a team environment
Coursework and familiarity with RF and satellite communications principles
Experience using Claude or similar AI development tools is a plus
Benefits
Relocation assistance is available pending eligibility.
Additional cash or stock incentives may be provided as part of the compensation package.
A range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position offered.
Flexible work environment; onsite/hybrid work is determined by individual roles and teams. Site-based employees work 3+ days (60%+) per week from a Viasat office or work location within a standard five-day work week.
